resolution.note: ship edits the PR only when title/body differ; CI edited event no longer cancels the run in progress; tests red first then green

title: A repeated ship leaves an unchanged PR body alone and a body edit does not cancel the Check run
body:
Evidence: PR #1551 2026-11-20: each krn pr ship call re-edited the PR body; the 'edited' pull_request event started a new CI run that cancelled the run ship was watching (runs 44780963518, 44780966351 cancelled by 44781928074), so ship exited 74 on cancelled runs.
Outcome: krn pr ship edits the PR body only when its text changed, and a body edit does not start or cancel the required Check run (workflow trigger or concurrency group excludes body-only edits).
Proof: a ship test from a verbatim gh capture shows no pr edit call when the body is unchanged; the workflow file test asserts the edited trigger is filtered or absent.
Files: src/ci/ship.ts, .github/workflows/, test/ci/ship.test.ts
